page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No marginal notes. Running head at top, page number at top right. Signature at the foot.

main_text.l: minam, viget tamen ordo charitatis inter
maritus metu tyranni profugerat, & rex so-
ut si sensissem illum moliri fugam, non me il-
mitem additura fuerim? Talem etiam fidem
gius,&c. Præterea cùm muliebris sexus per-
se sit imbecillis,maximè opus habet duce ac
capite, hoc est, viro, ex quo defensionem &
cum Deo, quæ ei sit copulata & conjuncta
cessabit, nisi priùs impleatur numerus ele-
storum & vocatorum ad nuptias filii Dei:

page.notes: Handwritten ink underlining over "inquit, Dionysiine", "judicas", "fugam, non me", "fortunarum", "fuerim", "præstabant olim uxores" and "maritis,quemadmodum" is not printed and has been left out; the printed words are transcribed. "Dionysiine" is doubtful because the underline obscures the letters; it may be "Dionysii ne" or a printing variant. The "ele-storum" line opens with a small mark in the margin that is not text. Running head read as "NVPTIALES." from the scan.
